name: helm-navigator
description: Formatter and cross-chart navigation for Helm charts: values.yaml, templates, _helpers.tpl, and parent/child (umbrella/sub) charts.

helmNavigator.format.yaml.description: Format pure YAML chart files (Chart.yaml, Chart.lock, requirements.yaml, values*.yaml). The result is discarded if the parsed data or comments would change.

helmNavigator.format.normalizeActions.description: Normalize whitespace inside template actions, e.g. `{{.Values.x|quote}}` -> `{{ .Values.x | quote }}`. Never changes rendered output.

helmNavigator.format.tplIndentControlAct.description: In .tpl files, indent lines that consist only of a left-trimmed action (`{{- if ... }}`) by control-structure nesting depth. Safe because `{{-` removes the preceding whitespace.

helmNavigator.format.templateIndentContr.description: Same as tplIndentControlActions, but for templates/*.yaml. Off by default because many charts align control actions with the YAML they guard.

helmNavigator.valuesFiles.description: Additional values files (relative to each chart directory) used for navigation, in increasing precedence order, applied to every environment. The chart's own values.yaml is always the lowest layer. Example: ["values-common.yaml"].

helmNavigator.environments.markdownDescription:
Deployment environments, each a chain of values files (relative to each chart directory, increasing precedence) layered on top of `values.yaml` and `helmNavigator.valuesFiles` — the files you pass with `helm -f`. Hover shows the effective value per environment; go to definition, references, rename and diagnostics cover every environment. Example:
```json
{
  "prod": ["environments/values.yaml", "environments/prod/values.yaml"],
  "uat": ["environments/uat/values.yaml"]
}
```

helmNavigator.diagnostics.enabled.description: Warn on template references to `.Values` keys that no values file sets (except `*` paths, refs guarded by `default`/`required`, and keys under an open `{}`/`[]`/`null` value), and hint values keys that no template in the chart tree reads. Charts unpacked from `charts/*.tgz` and library charts are not checked.

helmNavigator.assignLanguages.markdownDescription: Inside a chart (a folder with `Chart.yaml` above the file), open templates as **Helm Template** and values files (`values*.yaml`, `*-values.yaml`, `helmNavigator.valuesFiles`, `helmNavigator.environments`) as **Helm Values**, even when `files.associations` maps `*.yaml` to `yaml`. Files outside charts are left as they are. Helm Values files are not validated by Red Hat YAML / JSON Schema.

enumDescriptions: Ask once per workspace that contains a Helm chart
Silently set it in every workspace that contains a Helm chart
helmNavigator.autoSetDefaultFormatter.description: When a workspace contains a Helm chart, set Helm Navigator as the workspace default formatter for [yaml], [helm-template] and [helmignore] (written to .vscode/settings.json).
